title: Simplex weights minimising a V-weighted predictor discrepancy — sc_weights_simplex
text: Solves synthetic-control weight problem exactly: $$\min_w (Z_1 - Z_0' w)' V (Z_1 - Z_0' w) + \lambda \sum_j w_j   (Z_1 - Z_{0j})' V (Z_1 - Z_{0j})$$ unit simplex (w >= 0, sum(w) = 1), V = diag(v) lambda Abadie-L'Hour penalty (zero default, classic synthetic control).

title: Simplex weights minimising a V-weighted predictor discrepancy — sc_weights_simplex
text: primal active-set method – Lawson Hanson's non-negative least squares algorithm, adapted simplex. keeps working set donors, solves equality-constrained problem set exactly (pseudo-inverse, singular set handled), steps back feasibility weight turn negative, adds donor whose gradient violates optimality. stops exact KKT point: every donor positive weight gradient donor lower one. Starting nearest donor, typically needs two steps per donor final support. Two alternatives tried rejected. first-order (Frank-Wolfe) solve needs 12,000 iterations highly collinear pre-period outcomes Proposition 99 panel, practical iteration cap returns weights well short optimum. dual QP solver needs ridge make singular quadratic term invertible, penalty makes problem nearly linear solve numerically unreliable.

title: Simplex weights minimising a V-weighted predictor discrepancy — sc_weights_simplex
text: treated unit lies inside donors' convex hull, many weight vectors can fit predictors equally well, imply different counterfactuals. returned depends order donors enter working set – deterministic, arbitrary. fit_scm() warns fit exact. positive penalty makes solution unique (Abadie L'Hour 2021).
